name: get_account
description: The CartViral account behind this API key: plan and how it is billed (monthly or yearly), credit balance, credit price of each clip type, the price of every plan on both billing intervals, and the Earn (creator marketplace) profile if any. Call this first.

name: import_products
description: Import products into the account's catalog from a public link: a Shopify storefront link imports the whole published catalog (up to 750 products); a WooCommerce store link imports its catalog; a product page on Shopify, Amazon, TikTok Shop, Etsy or most other sites imports that product.

name: list_products
description: Products in the account's catalog with their id, price, photo count and CartViral score (0-100; 'push' products are the best candidates for clips). Use the id with generate_clips.

name: get_listing_copy
description: Marketplace-ready copy for one catalog product, written only from its real facts (never invented specs, claims or reviews) - the same claims as its clips.

name: get_copy
description: One of Text & SEO's 4 more tools for a catalog product, written only from its real facts (never invented specs, claims, discounts or reviews). tool=ad_copy: 5 Meta primary texts, 5 headlines, 5 descriptions, 3 TikTok ad texts, following the paid-ad rules (no absolutes, no fake discounts or reviews).

name: generate_clips
description: Queue vertical 9:16 clips (TikTok, Reels, Shorts) of one catalog product.

name: remake_from_reference
description: Turn a proven video into a new clip starring one of your catalog products: CartViral's engine watches the reference end to end (its hook, beats and pacing), then writes and shoots a new script around your product, never the reference's people or brand.

name: list_clips
description: Recent clips of the account's catalog, newest first, with render status and, when done, a download link and a stream link (both valid for 24 hours).

name: generate_photos
description: Queue a set of AI photos for one catalog product.

name: list_photo_sets
description: Recent AI photo sets of the account's catalog, newest first, with render status and, when done, a zip download link and each image's view/download links (square 2000x2000 and portrait 1080x1350).

name: generate_carousel
description: Queue a multi-slide carousel (Instagram and TikTok slides) for one catalog product, built only from its real facts: 3 credits per set, a few minutes to render. format picks the content idea (e.g.

name: list_carousels
description: Recent carousels of the account's catalog, newest first, with render status, the hook and caption CartViral wrote and, when done, a zip download link and each slide's Instagram/TikTok image links.

name: generate_static_ads
description: Queue a set of static ad images (Meta, TikTok) for one catalog product, built from its own photos with exact text, never an invented claim, fake discount or review: 4 credits per set no matter how many templates are picked, each template rendered at 3 sizes (1:1, 4:5, 9:16).

name: list_static_ads
description: Recent static ad sets of the account's catalog, newest first, with render status, the ad copy CartViral wrote and, when done, a zip download link and each image's view/download link.

name: list_offers
description: For creators: live brand offers in the CartViral Earn marketplace, with commission, ships-to countries, the clip formats the brand prefers, whether the brand's deposit is funded, and your personal link for offers you joined. Requires an Earn profile (create it once at app.cartviral.com/earn/start).

name: join_offer
description: For creators: join a live brand offer and get your personal tracking link. Free.

name: bring_a_brand
description: Paste a brand's store or product link: CartViral imports it, makes 3 AI clips of its best product (18 credits) and returns a public page to send the brand, with a "Launch your offer" button that carries this account's referral code (30% of what the brand pays CartViral, for life). Max 10 a day.

name: list_pitches
description: Pitches made with bring_a_brand: page link, render progress, how many times the brand opened it and clicked "Launch your offer".

name: get_create_options
description: What the Create tools accept and cost: video models (our engine Gemini Omni Flash, plus premium models when switched on) with credits per length, frames, camera moves, brand film moods, and the price of every Create tool. Free.

name: upload_media
description: Store an image (JPG, PNG, WebP, up to 8 MB) or a video (MP4, MOV, WebM, up to 60 MB) in CartViral and get its /u/ link for the Create tools. Pass a public https file link or the file as base64. You rarely need this: every Create tool also takes a public link directly. Free.

name: create_image
description: Images from your own prompt, optionally guided by up to 3 reference photos (a face, a product, a style, a layout): covers and YouTube thumbnails (use 16:9), banners, product scenes, posters. Not tied to the catalog. 1 credit per image, 1, 2 or 4 images. Poll list_creations.

name: create_video
description: A short video (4-10 s) from your own prompt, optionally starting from or guided by up to 3 reference photos, with a camera move (dolly_zoom, crane, orbit, push_in, whip_pan, low_angle) and sound. Our engine costs 2 credits per video; premium models cost more (see get_create_options).

name: make_angles
description: New angles of the same shoot from one photo (three-quarter, side, top, macro, low, front, wide, detail): 4 angles 4 credits, 6 angles 6 credits, 8 angles 8 credits. Poll list_creations.

name: make_talking_photo
description: A person's photo says your text on camera, in any language (up to 700 characters). 2 credits per take of up to 10 s (about 26 words); model avatar (Kling Avatar, when available) costs more. Needs consent=true for a real person. Poll list_creations.

name: make_cinematic
description: A 15 or 30 s image film of a product with a pro model, every frame usable as a banner: for a site, ads and banners. Pass a catalog product_id or up to 3 product photos. 12 credits for 15 s and 18 for 30 s on our engine; premium models cost more (get_create_options). Poll list_creations.

name: reframe_video
description: Re-cut a video (up to 2 minutes) to another frame: 9:16, 4:5, 1:1 or 16:9, filling the frame or on a blurred background. 1 credit. Poll list_creations.

name: remove_background
description: A cut-out PNG with a transparent background plus a white-background JPG. 1 credit. Poll list_creations.

name: copy_motion
description: The person from a photo repeats the movement of a reference video (dance, gesture, walk), up to 15 s. Premium, priced by length; only when premium video is switched on. Needs consent=true for a real person. Poll list_creations.

name: breakdown_video
description: Why a video works: hook and its mechanism, beats with timings, what is said and shown, on-screen text style, measured cuts. Free. To make the same structure with your product, use remake_from_reference. Poll list_creations (the result is data).

name: create_character
description: Two portraits of a recurring person for the brand (who, age, look, or from a real person's photo with consent), 2 credits. Then save_character with the portrait you like; generate_clips and remake_from_reference take its character_id so the same face stars in every clip.

name: save_character
description: Keep one of the create_character portraits (or any portrait link) as the brand's character. Returns its character_id. Free.

name: list_characters
description: The brand's saved characters with their character_id, look and portrait. Free.

name: list_creations
description: Status and result links of Create jobs (images, videos, angles, talking photos, brand films, reframes, cut-outs, motion copies, breakdowns, character portraits). Pass job_id for one job. status: queued, rendering, done or error (a failed job refunds its credits). Free.
